rationale: Braking behavior itself must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking under SG-3 and the H-3 hazardous event. Relating braking to a valid obstacle-related cause is supported by H-3’s stopping-without-an-obstacle event and FR-7’s collision-avoidance braking function. The declared scope matches the supplied operational situation. P does not expand into sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing.
determining_elements: “Braking behavior of the ego vehicle,” including whether braking occurs, directly identifies the behavior evaluated by T.
“Whether it is intended in response to a valid obstacle-related cause” captures the relationship supported by H-3 and FR-7 without incorporating obstacle-detection mechanisms.
The scope preserves H-3’s straight-ahead urban driving at 50 km/h, good weather, and absence of visible obstacles or vehicles ahead.
